verdict.rationale: The evidence shows UKVI's founder-route application is online-only and that processing times are published. Nothing in the pack documents operating hours, per-day submission limits, or session timeouts for the online flow being disclosed before an applicant starts. The 'apply up to 3 months before' rule is an eligibility timing window, not an operating-hours or session constraint, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
